messages:
sara: Heads-up: I want to tighten RBAC for the on-prem keystore agent in priv-deploy. Goal: drop clusterrole, use namespace-scoped Roles + explicit audit write perms.

leo: Good. Can you list the minimal verbs/namespaced resources?

sara: Draft: Role `keystore-reader` in `keystore` ns -> `get,list,watch` on `secrets` and `pods`. Role `keystore-rotator` -> `update` on `secrets/keystore-certs` only. Role `keystore-auditor` -> `create` on `events` and `create` on `auditlogs.mycompany.io` CRD. Bind to SA `keystore-agent`. No ClusterRole required.

dmitri: Important: ensure kube-apiserver audit entries still surface SA email and we can correlate with HSM logs.

sara: We will add a webhook transformer that injects `x-rw-request-id` (sha256) and preserve `user.username` as `system:serviceaccount:keystore:keystore-agent`. KMS/HSM calls already log request IDs; we'll crosslink on `x-rw-request-id`.

sec-bot: [automated] Please dry-run RBAC reconcile: `kubectl auth reconcile --manifest=keystore-roles.yaml --dry-run=server`

leo: Netpol: deny all ingress to `keystore` ns, allow egress only to HSM CIDRs (TCP 1696), DNS and NTP. No control-plane egress. Add hostNetwork exceptions for CNI probes.

sara: Draft netpol included in PR. I'll add annotation for hostNetwork probes per CNI vendors.

dmitri: Vulnerability triage: scanner flagged old libssl in agent image. We must NOT combine RBAC/netpol rollout with image bump. Plan: RBAC+NetPol first, verify, then image patch in separate rollout.

leo: For incident response: if agents hit 403s -> alert `KeystoreAuthFailures` should fire. Runbook steps: 1) `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:keystore:keystore-agent get secrets/keystore-certs`, 2) fetch apiserver audit entries: `kubectl get apiserver-audit --selector=request_id=<id>`, 3) if misconfig revert RoleBinding, 4) open channel `#priv-deploy-ops` and collect KMS traces.

sec-bot: [automated] Runbook template: https://confluence.internal/redwood/keystore-hardening-runbook (created)

compliance: Must have ephemeral elevated access for SREs: issue OIDC short-lived tokens (30m) via internal portal with mandatory session recording and attestation. No static breakglass keys.

leo: Add prom alert:
```yaml
alert: KeystoreAuthFailures
expr: increase(keystore_agent_errors_total{code=\"403\"}[5m]) > 0
for: 1m
annotations:
  runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/keystore-hardening-runbook
```

sara: Will add the Prom rule and a Grafana panel for KMS latency (p50/p95) to detect rotation stalls.

dmitri: Preflight checklist: auth-can-i for all automation SAs, netpol simulator, smoke: read secret, rotate key, verify audit webhook entry contains `x-rw-request-id`.

sara: Test matrix added to PR: smoke read, rotate, audit correlation (10 samples), netpol connectivity. Target staging canary 5% for 1h tomorrow 07:30 UTC.

leo: ACK. Tagging @dmitri @compliance for review. :lock:
